AST comparison of src/{cli,ops,reducer,views,extension,types}.ts with string literals masked shows only string/join-separator changes, except views.ts itemText now always prints the label (old '封' special case removed; ⛔ blocked is rendered) - display only. The updated assertions in cli/extension/reducer tests are equivalent in strength (Attribution is slightly stricter; Merges and defer were already loose on base). english.test.ts drives real CLI and extension paths, including refusals, owner confirmation prompts and doc scans. Ran in a detached worktree: tsc --noEmit exit 0; node --test english/cli/extension/reducer 31/31 pass. Non-blocking: missing space after colon at src/cli.ts:55 (failed:), src/ops.ts:123 (accepted:), src/reducer.ts:345 (unsatisfied:); reducer downgradeDetails wording still differs from plan.ts planDowngrades (pre-existing), so downgrade lists may show duplicates; english.test.ts does not scan bin/ or dev/plan.yaml (dev/plan.yaml still has CJK but is not user-facing).

plans.35549e9031983f05c705a402bf049ab6f8f61443:
closure:
  - dev/**
  - test/helpers/**
  - tsconfig.json
  - tsconfig.build.json
  - package.json
  - package-lock.json
invariants:
  - id: typecheck
    reads:
      - src/**
      - test/**
      - tsconfig.json
      - package.json
    run: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
    timeout_s: 300
  - id: suite
    min_tests: 44
    reads:
      - "**"
    run: node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-reporter=tap 'test/**/*.test.ts'
    timeout_s: 900
nodes:
  - brief: >
      Add `owed gc [--dry-run]` (CLI) and `ops.gc({cwd, dryRun})`. It removes
      the slot worktree

      (`git worktree remove`, refusing dirty ones: list them as kept) and
      deletes the branch

      `owed/<node>/<attempt>` for every attempt that is merged or abandoned,
      never for an open

      slot; then runs `git worktree prune`. It appends a `note` entry describing
      what was removed

      (no new entry kind). Output lists removed/kept with reasons; `--json`
      returns

      `{removed:[{node,attempt,worktree,branch}], kept:[{...,reason}]}`.
      Idempotent: a second run

      removes nothing. Document in docs/SPEC.md §8/§10 and README.
    checks:
      - id: gc
        min_tests: 3
        reads:
          - src/**
          - bin/**
          - test/gc.test.ts
        red: true
        red_expect: ERR_ASSERTION
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/gc.test.ts
        tests:
          - test/gc.test.ts
        timeout_s: 300
    deps: []
    id: gc
    review:
      count: 1
      min_rank: 1
    title: owed gc — reclaim finished worktrees and branches
    writes:
      - src/ops.ts
      - src/git.ts
      - src/cli.ts
      - docs/SPEC.md
      - README.md
      - test/gc.test.ts
  - brief: >
      Add `owed brief [--since seq|ISO]` (CLI), `ops.brief(...)`,
      `views.renderBrief(...)` and a

      pi tool `owed_brief`. Sections, in this order, each item one line: (1)
      需要你决定 — owner

      queue items, sorted by number of transitively blocked downstream nodes,
      each with the exact

      command that discharges it; (2) 已合并 — per merged node: counts of ✔
      measured / ⚠ waived

      obligations, 未测改动 count, reviewers; (3) 被拒或被封 — active blocks with node,
      obligation,

      the failing obs seq and how to clear; (4) 进行中 — dispatched/submitted nodes
      with age;

      (5) 一行总计 (merged / accepted-unmerged / blocked / ready counts). A waived
      item must never

      be shown as measured. Plain text by default, `--json` returns the
      structured view. Document in

      SPEC §9 and README.
    checks:
      - id: brief
        min_tests: 3
        reads:
          - src/**
          - bin/**
          - test/brief.test.ts
        red: true
        red_expect: ERR_ASSERTION
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/brief.test.ts
        tests:
          - test/brief.test.ts
        timeout_s: 300
    deps: []
    id: brief
    review:
      count: 1
      min_rank: 1
    title: Morning brief — what finished, what was rejected, what needs the owner
    writes:
      - src/ops.ts
      - src/views.ts
      - src/cli.ts
      - src/extension.ts
      - docs/SPEC.md
      - README.md
      - test/brief.test.ts
  - brief: >
      New entry kinds (types.ts Entry union, reducer, validateDraft):

      - `escape` {node, merge: seq of the merge entry, class:
      'missing'|'false-pass'|'reuse'|'weak'|'waiver',
        note, evidence?: string}: a defect found after a node was merged. by parent or owner. class
        maps to escape classes ② / ①a / ①b / ①c / ③ (missing obligation; false affirmative obs;
        unsound evidence reuse; weak oracle; owner waiver). Refuse if `merge` is not a merge of `node`.
      - `decoy-commit` {digest} by owner only: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON
      of the reveal payload
        {nonce, decoys:[{node, defect}]}.
      - `decoy-reveal` {nonce, decoys:[{node, defect}]} by owner only: refused
      unless it hashes to an
        earlier unrevealed decoy-commit made before every listed node was first dispatched.
      Reducer derives `state.escapes` and `state.decoys` with per-decoy outcome:
      'caught' (the decoy

      node got an execution or judgment block, or a rejecting obs, before any
      merge of it),

      'escaped' (merged with no prior block), 'pending' (neither yet). Metrics:
      escape counts by

      class; decoys caught / escaped / pending; escape rate = escaped / (caught
      + escaped).

      CLI: `owed escape <node> --merge N --class C --note T`, `owed decoy commit
      <digest>`,

      `owed decoy reveal <file.json>`, `owed decoy digest <file.json>` (helper,
      no ledger write),

      and a 逃逸 section in `owed report`. Owner commands use the existing owner
      channel rules.

      Document in SPEC (entry kinds, reducer, CLI) and README (north-star
      metric).
    checks:
      - id: escape
        min_tests: 5
        reads:
          - src/**
          - bin/**
          - test/escape.test.ts
        red: true
        red_expect: ERR_ASSERTION
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/escape.test.ts
        tests:
          - test/escape.test.ts
        timeout_s: 300
    deps: []
    id: escape
    review:
      count: 1
      min_rank: 1
    title: Escape ledger and commit-reveal decoys (the north-star metric)
    writes:
      - src/types.ts
      - src/reducer.ts
      - src/ops.ts
      - src/cli.ts
      - src/views.ts
      - docs/SPEC.md
      - README.md
      - test/escape.test.ts
  - brief: >
      CheckSpec gains `mutants?: string[]` (globs of patch files that must lie
      inside the plan

      closure; validate in plan.ts) and `min_kill?: number` in (0,1], default 1.
      For such a check

      the node gets obligation `strength:<check id>` (items list, keys,
      attestJobs). Executor: for

      each mutant patch (read from the base B, never from the candidate)
      materialize the candidate,

      overlay closure from B as for the check, `git apply` the patch (a patch
      that does not apply

      counts as not killed and is reported), run the check command; killed iff
      exit != 0 or failing

      tests > 0 (a zero-test run is not a kill). Verdict pass iff killed/total
      >= min_kill; record

      counts {tests: total, pass: killed, fail: survived} and a log listing each
      mutant result.

      Key = H(o:'strength', id, run, timeout_s, setup, min_tests, closure digest
      of B, mutants digest

      of B, readsDigest(C, reads)) — changes when the candidate's read set, the
      check or any

      mutant changes. A failed strength obs is an execution block like any
      other. The receipt card

      shows "强度 k/n". Document in SPEC (§3 schema, §4 keys, §7 executor) and
      README.
    checks:
      - id: strength
        min_tests: 4
        reads:
          - src/**
          - bin/**
          - test/strength.test.ts
        red: true
        red_expect: ERR_ASSERTION
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/strength.test.ts
        tests:
          - test/strength.test.ts
        timeout_s: 600
    deps: []
    id: strength
    review:
      count: 1
      min_rank: 1
    title: Mutation counterfactuals — measure oracle strength
    writes:
      - src/types.ts
      - src/plan.ts
      - src/git.ts
      - src/exec.ts
      - src/reducer.ts
      - src/views.ts
      - docs/SPEC.md
      - README.md
      - test/strength.test.ts
setup: ln -s "$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute
  --git-common-dir)")/node_modules" node_modules
trunk: main
version: 1
